add.k: An ex-con from Queens charged with murder
st: Charged with killing Lisa Tazzio, Dante swears to Matt he is innocent, testifies at his trial, and is cleared.

files.notes: Director's Cut only. Name said on screen ('Dante Jackson ex-con from Queens', 'Mr. Jackson', 'Ladies and gentlemen of the jury... Dante Jackson'), checked against a fan transcription of the Director's Cut scenes (the springfield transcript is the theatrical cut). No group named on screen: Independent.

st: Years earlier, Fallon tells Jack Murdock his wins were bought and orders him to take a fall, then has him killed for winning.

files.notes: Only 'Fallon' is said in the theatrical transcript ('They said that you work for Fallon', 'I don't work for you no more, Fallon'); 'Eddie' not found in dialogue, so n is Fallon. Fisk later says 'I was working for Fallon at the time' when he killed Jack. Fallon's death is not shown, so status At large. Group uses the app's existing 'Fallon's Mob'.

st: Hirsch defends Jose Quesada against Matt, smears Angela Sutton's past in court, and wins Quesada an acquittal.

files.notes: Foggy names him ('How can a scumbag like Quesada afford an attorney like Hirsh?') and says the Kingpin is footing the bill. A paid lawyer is a one-job hire, not a member of Fisk's Empire; his firm is never named: Independent.

add.k: A forensics assistant who sells tips to Ben Urich
st: Paid by Ben Urich, Kirby shows him that Daredevil's baton unfolds into a blind man's walking cane.

files.notes: Only the surname is said ('This better be good, Kirby'); 'Jack' appears only in the credits, so n is Kirby. Forensics job from Wikipedia's cast note; no employer named on screen: Independent.

st: Karen keeps Nelson & Murdock running and, reading Matt's note on the Tazzio case another way, helps Foggy tie it to Wesley.

files.notes: Her name is said only in Director's Cut scenes ('I'd love a cup Karen', 'You should really get home Karen'), checked against a fan transcription; the theatrical transcript never says it. In that scene she asks the date of the murder and the note MOM 68 read upside down gives August 9 and WOW, which Foggy reads as Wesley Owen Welch. Separate version from the app's MCU Karen; surname from credits only, but she is the app's known Karen Page.

add.k: A criminal marked for death by Elektra
st: DeMarco waits behind his guards, sure Elektra is coming after she cut down the Hand's men, and she kills him with her sai.

files.notes: Named by McCabe ('We were only getting paid for DeMarco'). He says he was under the Hand's protection but is not a member; no group of his own named: Independent. Filed on the Raft as a criminal, like Jose Quesada.

add.k: A Hand officer serving Master Roshi
st: Meizumi takes on the hunt for the Treasure, but Elektra kills his men and Roshi hands the task to Kirigi.

files.notes: Named by Roshi ('Then work smoothly, Meizumi, but quickly'). Speaker attribution in the council scenes is from the transcript lines plus wiki pages ('Master Roshi gave that task to me... my men are taking care of it').

add.k: The leader of the Hand and Kirigi's father
st: Roshi presides over the Hand's council and, after Meizumi's men fail, gives his son Kirigi the hunt for the Treasure.

files.notes: Called 'Master Roshi' on screen; Kirigi answers him 'Yes, Father'. He tells Kirigi completing the task will prove him worthy of leading the council. The wiki says he ordered Elektra's mother's death; not confirmed on screen, so left out. Threat level Global as head of an international order: judgment call.

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Matt takes Dante's murder case after hearing his heartbeat and believing he is innocent. He makes the opening statement and tracks the lie back to Officer McKenzie, and Dante is cleared and thanks him.
stages.whoA: His defense attorney, who believes him

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Foggy doubts Dante at first, calling him a three-time loser. With Matt missing, Foggy questions Dante on the stand alone and struggles through Matt's Braille notes before the case is won.
stages.whoA: His other lawyer, who doubts him at first
stages.whoB: A client he defends alone in court

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Karen works for Foggy and Matt at their small firm. Staying late with Foggy on the Tazzio case, she asks the date of the murder and helps him see that Matt's note points to Wesley Owen Welch.

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Karen works for Matt at Nelson & Murdock and keeps the office going. When Matt goes missing during the Dante Jackson trial, she tells Foggy not to worry.

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Jack works as muscle for Fallon, then tries to box clean. Fallon tells him his wins were bought and orders him to take a fall, and when Jack wins anyway Fallon has him killed.
stages.whoB: The mob boss who has him killed

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Before he becomes the Kingpin, Fisk works for Fallon. He kills Jack Murdock when Jack refuses to throw his fight, and later tells Matt it was just business.
stages.whoB: The mob boss he once worked for

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Hirsch defends Quesada at his rape trial, objecting to Matt's questions and attacking Angela Sutton's past. Quesada walks free, and Foggy guesses the Kingpin paid the bill.
stages.whoA: His client, whom he gets acquitted

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Hirsch faces Matt in court in the Quesada trial. He objects to Matt's line on perjury and wins the acquittal that Matt calls another rapist back on the streets.
stages.whoA: Angela Sutton's lawyer, whom he beats in court
stages.whoB: Quesada's attorney, who beats him in court

stages.title: Daredevil (2003)
stages.text: Kirby sells Urich tips about anything weird. For cash he shows Urich that Daredevil's baton unfolds into a blind man's cane, a clue that points Urich toward Matt.
stages.whoA: The reporter who pays him for tips
stages.whoB: A paid source with access to evidence

stages.title: Elektra
stages.text: Elektra is hired to kill DeMarco. She cuts down his guards and the Hand's men, lets him run, then reaches him past his last guards and kills him with a thrown sai.
stages.whoA: The assassin who hunts him down

stages.title: Elektra
stages.text: Meizumi serves Master Roshi on the Hand's council and asks for the task of taking the Treasure. When his men fail, Roshi gives the task to Kirigi instead.
stages.whoA: His master, head of the Hand
stages.whoB: His officer who fails to take the Treasure

stages.title: Elektra
stages.text: Kirigi tells the council that Meizumi's careful methods have failed and that his men are dead. Meizumi calls Kirigi's forces an abomination, but Kirigi wins the task.
stages.whoA: A rival who takes his task
stages.whoB: A council rival whose men failed

stages.title: Elektra
stages.text: Kirigi is Roshi's son and calls him Father. Roshi gives him the hunt for the Treasure and promises to step aside as head of the council if he succeeds.
stages.whoB: His father, master of the Hand

changes.was: DeMarco waits behind his guards and the Hand's protection, sure Elektra is coming, and she kills him with her sai.
changes.now: DeMarco waits behind his guards, sure Elektra is coming after she cut down the Hand's men, and she kills him with her sai.
changes.why: DeMarco says he WAS under the Hand's protection and Elektra already cut those men down; at the end he has only his own security (Bauer's teams).

changes.where: tie Dante Jackson / Matt Murdock text
changes.was: Matt takes Dante's murder case after hearing his heartbeat and believing he is innocent. He questions Dante in court and tracks the lie back to Officer McKenzie, and Dante is cleared and thanks him.
changes.now: Matt takes Dante's murder case after hearing his heartbeat and believing he is innocent. He makes the opening statement and tracks the lie back to Officer McKenzie, and Dante is cleared and thanks him.
changes.why: Matt never questions Dante in court: he gives the opening statement and examines McKenzie; Foggy questions Dante alone ('I'm working alone here today') while Matt is missing.
changes.source: Director's Cut scene transcription (RiffTrax Recycled Daredevil Director's Cut scenes 24 and 33), saved at build/work_66/rt.txt
